about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Engineering Scalable Web & Mobile Products
bioParagraphs: I am a Software Developer with 3+ years of professional experience engineering production-grade web and mobile applications at Lamda Logs. I specialize in building scalable user interfaces, decoupled state architectures, and optimizing client-side performance.

Throughout my tenure at Lamda Logs, I have spearheaded frontend initiatives from zero to production for diverse client domains—ranging from AI generative platforms and spatial enterprise asset portals to real-time logistics tracking and mobile health apps.

pillars.title: Clean Architecture
pillars.description: Building modular, decoupled component systems with strict TypeScript typing and predictable state management.

pillars.title: Performance Optimization
pillars.description: Achieving sub-second loading through aggressive code-splitting, bundle auditing, and smart client caching.

pillars.title: Cross-Platform Mobile
pillars.description: Engineering fluid iOS & Android mobile apps with React Native, featuring 60 FPS native animations and offline persistence.

pillars.title: Enterprise Reliability
pillars.description: Enforcing WCAG accessibility guidelines, structured UI component libraries, and automated CI/CD pipelines.

experienceSection.title: Work Experience
experienceSection.subtitle: 3+ Years of SDE Experience at Lamda Logs

experiences.description: Engineering production frontend systems, mobile applications, and high-throughput client platforms for enterprise clients across AI, Spatial Asset Management, Logistics, Food Tech, and Health.
responsibilities: Architected and deployed 6+ production web and mobile applications using React 19, Next.js, React Native, and TypeScript 5.8.
Reduced client-side bundle sizes by 32% and eliminated redundant API requests by 25% using TanStack Query and Zustand.
Established reusable atomic UI design systems with Tailwind CSS, Radix UI primitives, and Framer Motion micro-interactions.
Mentored junior frontend developers, enforced strict code review guidelines, and established automated CI/CD deployment pipelines.

projectsSection.title: Production Case Studies
projectsSection.subtitle: Key Applications & Client Products Built During SDE Tenure

projects.title: Matisse AI Studio
projects.subtitle: Generative Creative Suite & Prompt Engineering Workspace
projects.description: A high-performance web platform designed for AI-driven image generation, prompt curation, and real-time canvas rendering.
projects.challenge: Rendering high-resolution AI generated assets without browser thread blocking or canvas layout latency.
projects.solution: Built asynchronous WebWorker asset decoders, canvas virtualizers, and optimistic UI state management with Zustand.

projects.title: Heptaverse B2B Portal
projects.subtitle: Spatial VR/AR Enterprise Asset Management Platform
projects.description: Enterprise WebGL dashboard enabling B2B clients to inspect, configure, and manage 3D spatial assets and virtual environment permissions.
projects.challenge: Managing complex 3D WebGL scenes alongside real-time asset metadata synchronization.
projects.solution: Integrated Three.js and React Three Fiber with custom instanced geometry rendering and modular scene graph controls.

projects.title: Aegis Fleet Tracker
projects.subtitle: Real-Time Fleet Telematics & Asset Logistics Dashboard
projects.description: Real-time fleet telemetry monitoring dashboard tracking vehicle location, speed, fuel efficiency, and route optimization across 1,000+ active units.
projects.challenge: Handling high-frequency WebSocket GPS telemetry streams without DOM re-render lag.
projects.solution: Implemented throttled state batching, Canvas map overlays, and TanStack Query cache invalidation strategies.

projects.title: Bizmitr Dealer Portal
projects.subtitle: Enterprise B2B Dealer Order Management & Inventory Portal
projects.description: Streamlined B2B portal for authorized dealers to place bulk orders, track shipment manifests, inspect credit terms, and manage product inventory.
projects.challenge: Complex multi-step quotation formulas and dynamic bulk order matrix tables.
projects.solution: Created an atomic form state machine with React Hook Form, Zod schema validation, and optimized virtual table rendering.

projects.title: Jalsa Bitez Ecosystem
projects.subtitle: Multi-Outlet Food Ordering & Kitchen POS System
projects.description: End-to-end digital menu, QR ordering interface, and kitchen display system (KDS) for multi-location restaurant chains.
projects.challenge: Maintaining sub-second order dispatch sync between customer mobile Web App and kitchen POS displays.
projects.solution: Designed offline-first local storage queues and resilient HTTP polling fallbacks.

projects.title: Empowering Fitness App
projects.subtitle: Cross-Platform Health Tracking & Workout Companion App
projects.description: Cross-platform iOS and Android mobile app providing custom workout plans, biometric tracking, habit streak reminders, and trainer chat.
projects.challenge: Delivering smooth 60 FPS gesture-driven animations and biometric sensor synchronization on mobile devices.
projects.solution: Leveraged React Native Reanimated 3, Gesture Handler, and Native HealthKit / Google Fit bridges.
